title: Peer issue mechanisms, codec boundaries, and consumer routes
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source web research and plan-only crosswalk
scope: Recheck current ACadSharp issue reports for nested-block graph cost, EED width, MTEXT whole-file acceptance, and SPLINE-to-GDAL reports
Separate library API behavior from serialized DWG/DXF codec behavior and format requirements
Cross-check the peer mechanisms against local DRW_Insert and existing plan owners
Refresh GDAL and FreeCAD consumer-route boundaries for projected geometry, raw ASM, and DWG-to-DXF import

method.kind: Primary repository issue/docs review plus read-only local source crosswalk
method.limitations: GitHub issues and mutable main/master documentation were inspected as published on 2026-10-18; no peer artifact, issue attachment, GDAL binary, or native CAD application was run. Peer reports are not format authorities or evidence of a local defect. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layout.

sources.revision: issue bodies and mutable issue index accessed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: #1283 describes recursive deep-copy behavior in the Insert(BlockRecord) convenience API, quadratic construction time, and stack exhaustion; it is not a wire-format finding. #1282 reports signed-16-bit narrowing of per-APPID encoded EED size at 32,768 bytes. #1281 reports recursive DXF parser advancement on repeated constructs. #1297 reports whole-file AC1032 AutoCAD rejection for frame-only MTEXT flag 16 despite an entity-body byte-match; proposed missing-style causes are unproven. #1299 reports downstream GDAL failure on ACadSharp-produced SPLINE data but lacks public field arrays and exact diagnostic.

sources.revision: workspace at baseline commit de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9 plus pre-existing dirty changes
sources.observed: DRW_Insert carries a block-name reference and DWG handles instead of an owned nested BlockRecord graph. Existing plan owners already contain EED-size boundary vectors through 65,536 bytes, repeated-input bounds, graph traversal budgets, version-scoped MTEXT handling, and analytic spline checks. The ACadSharp clone-on-add API failure has no direct local equivalent established by this source comparison.
DXF MTEXT group 90 documents background-fill values 0, 1, and 2. This DXF carrier is distinct from the version-specific R2018 DWG text-frame flag discussed in ACadSharp #1297.

The CAD/DWG driver is a read-only libopencad-based projection with a small published geometry subset. The separate DXF driver tessellates/projects curves and can expose raw ASM bytes and transforms in opt-in AC1027+ mode, while documentation states that it does not convert ASM modeler data into OGR geometry.

FreeCAD's DWG path is converter-to-DXF followed by a selected DXF importer. ezdxf's drawing add-on documents no 3D engine, XY projection for 3D entities, and no ACIS rendering. These routes do not establish native solid semantics.

assessment.planImpact: Clarifies existing mechanism-specific owners and evidence gates. Keep ACadSharp #1283 as a peer API/performance lead rather than a codec defect; retain current EED, repeated-input, graph, MTEXT, and spline owners; require whole-file native checks where already composed; treat GDAL projection/raw ASM and FreeCAD converter routes as non-semantic for B-rep claims. No new finding, test, fixture, dependency, support promotion, or external-J transition.
